infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Kinly displays your location to trusted family members on the live family map.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Kinly shares background arrival and departure updates with your family circle.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kinly uses your microphone for voice notes and conversational family memories.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kinly uses your camera to capture memories and scan family documents into the vault.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kinly lets you select photos for family memories, albums, and member profiles.
